title: RDW–adiposity geometry improves source cross-validation but not transferred airflow-ratio prediction
abstract: An RDW-by-BMI tensor spline changed transferred weighted FEV1/FVC MSE from 0.00468366 to 0.00471045 (delta +0.00002679; joint PSU bootstrap95% [-0.00016907,+0.00065241]); incremental prediction was not established. Exploratory nonoverlapping-cycle transfer, not untouched confirmation or external-study validation.
